oracle.derivation: Run the self-contained deck in ngspice-44.2 with the explicit tolerances in the netlist. Read binary raw doubles by variable name. Transient samples retain up to 101 original accepted times; no interpolation was used to create these expected values.

confirmed.derivation: ngspice-45 manual (ngspice.sourceforge.io/docs/ngspice-45-manual.pdf) eq. 7.3: IDeff = ID/(1 + sqrt(ID/IKeff)) + VD*GMIN; 5 V through 100 ohm, solved by brentq: v(out) = 0.79830141851, i(vin) = -0.0420169858149. Xyce 7.10.0 reads IKF as ID/sqrt(1 + ID/IKF).
